purpose: Map each missing applicability fact/evidence evaluator to impacted Florida rule IDs; these cannot be automatically enforced until the missing primitive is implemented.

missing_facts.name: company.contracted_through_transportation_coordinator
why: Appendix C explicitly excepts providers contracted through coordinator.

missing_facts.name: company.fl_ahca_enrollment_required
why: Need classification determining whether this provider must directly enroll, rather than operating solely as a broker subcontractor.

missing_facts.name: company.fl_local_license_required
why: Local occupational, taxi or for-hire license depends on local jurisdiction and vehicle/service classification.

missing_facts.name: company.fl_local_td_service_plan
why: Cannot infer uniform first aid certificate requirement from this provision; the local plan determines it.
Local service plan and purchasers determine additional screening conditions; cannot be universalized.
There is no statewide universal two-year CPR certification mandate in this provision.

missing_facts.name: company.fl_transportation_enrollment_specialty
why: Only non-emergency, multi-load and taxicab provider specialties listed as requiring this bond.
Only private transportation and taxicab specialties require operator license under Appendix C.

missing_facts.name: company.is_tnc_under_627748
why: Digital medical dispatch alone does not establish TNC classification; Medicaid contracting may expressly exclude it.

missing_facts.name: driver.fit_for_duty_status
why: Need current fitness/safety-disqualification determination; past medical card not enough.

missing_facts.name: driver.florida_resident
why: Law expressly applies to Florida residents and does not universally ban qualified out-of-state CDL holders.

missing_facts.name: driver.last_qualifying_off_duty_period
why: Need verified off-duty periods and any permitted exceptions.

missing_facts.name: driver.medical_leave_30_or_more_days
why: Event-based conditional medical leave and return date not in current schema.

missing_facts.name: driver.projected_24h_driving_hours
why: Need driving-hour totals including intended trip and exception classification.

missing_facts.name: driver.projected_24h_on_duty_hours
why: Need on-duty time and projected trip duration.

missing_facts.name: driver.qualified_bus_vehicle_types
why: Qualification must be matched to the bus type rather than treating a generic training attendance as proficiency.

missing_facts.name: driver.seven_day_duty_hours_and_restart
why: Need 7-day rolling work hours and 24h rest reset information.

missing_facts.name: operation.fl_14_90_applicable
why: Chapter 14-90 applies to bus transit systems and covered private contractors under Florida Statute 341.061; company.transit alone cannot safely classify the operation.
Classification must determine whether 14-90 applies to vehicle/operator and which provisions.

missing_facts.name: operation.fl_ctc_coordinated
why: Chapter 41-2 requirements apply only to transportation purchased or arranged in the covered coordinated transportation-disadvantaged system; company.transit is broader.

missing_facts.name: trip.crosses_state_line
why: Need trip route state boundaries, not operation.interstate which means ever.

missing_facts.name: trip.driver_pickup_identification_exception
why: Requires trip events and whether rider is regularly transported by this driver.

missing_facts.name: trip.duplicates_other_covered_service
why: Requires trip/payer-level determination about duplication of already furnished services.

missing_facts.name: trip.escort_accommodation
why: Need trip escort seating and acceptance decision.

missing_facts.name: trip.escort_assigned
why: Trip escort assignment not available.

missing_facts.name: trip.escort_entitlement
why: Trip must record disability/assistance/age conditions qualifying for policy escort.

missing_facts.name: trip.escort_provider_employment_relation
why: Escort identity and employment relationship are not in schema.

missing_facts.name: trip.fl_medicaid_eligibility_status
why: Trip-specific beneficiary eligibility and applicable program eligibility on service date are not in current facts.

missing_facts.name: trip.fl_medicaid_fee_for_service
why: Policy §7.1 explicitly restricts this authorization instruction to FFS delivery.
Section 8.1 limits reimbursement language to AHCA broker context.

missing_facts.name: trip.is_ppec_transport
why: Trip requires PPEC service category.

missing_facts.name: trip.is_urgent_or_unscheduled
why: Trip urgency/unscheduled status not represented.

missing_facts.name: trip.medical_necessity_approved
why: Trip medical necessity or payer approval must be known.

missing_facts.name: trip.medically_approved_transport_mode
why: Requires licensed professional mode determination and trip transport classification.

missing_facts.name: trip.operates_in_florida
why: Only require Florida roadway compliance when assigned trip actually uses Florida highways; exemptions and out-of-state reciprocity must be respected.

missing_facts.name: trip.passenger_and_escort_seats_required
why: Number of occupied passenger/escort seats is trip-specific and not represented by vehicle.seats alone.

missing_facts.name: trip.passenger_needs_boarding_assistance
why: Need requested assistance and driver's ability to provide it.

missing_facts.name: trip.ppec_escort_medically_required
why: Trip escort medical necessity not available.

missing_facts.name: trip.recipient_no_other_transport
why: Beneficiary transport access is not a recognized TripProof fact.

missing_facts.name: trip.vehicle_actual_projected_weight
why: Need projected combined rider, wheelchair, equipment and vehicle load, axle/tire ratings.

missing_facts.name: vehicle.active_critical_defects
why: Needs defect severity, disposition and clearance, not only an inspection certificate.

missing_facts.name: vehicle.fl_insurance_proof_statute_applies
why: Requires identifying which financial security mandates apply to this vehicle and driver.

missing_facts.name: vehicle.fl_pip_security_required
why: School buses, limousines, taxicabs, nonresidents and other categories have different or additional treatment.

missing_facts.name: vehicle.fl_registration_required
why: Some nonresident and statutory exemptions apply, so cannot presume all vehicles must hold Florida registration.
Statute is tied to vehicles required to register in Florida.

missing_facts.name: vehicle.is_nonpublic_sector_bus
why: Applies to nonpublic-sector bus defined by law and excludes specified school buses.

missing_facts.name: vehicle.is_taxicab
why: Cannot treat every NEMT passenger van as a taxicab.

why: Each Appendix B item needs its own evidence mapping; cannot validate with a generic credential.

missing_evidence.name: assistance_proficiency_evaluation
why: A course document alone may not verify required testing/proficiency.

missing_evidence.name: driver_possession_of_vehicle_insurance_proof
why: Company insurance file does not establish that the operating driver has legally acceptable proof on hand.

missing_evidence.name: fdot_annual_safety_cert_submission
why: An annual submission receipt must be tracked by the bus transit system; not a per-driver qualification.

missing_evidence.name: fl_14_90_safety_inspection_compliance
why: Generic DOT annual inspection document may not demonstrate Florida Chapter 14-90 specific inspection protocol.

missing_evidence.name: fl_level1_or_approved_equivalent
why: Existing FL_LEVEL1 credential cannot confirm authorized functionally equivalent screening or eligibility result.

missing_evidence.name: fl_net_booking_policy_review
why: Provider reservation policy needs a verifiable compliance review, not a blanket trip failure.

missing_evidence.name: fl_net_claim_submission
why: Claims routing is not an assignment-time qualification.

missing_evidence.name: fl_net_escort_billing_control
why: Fare and billing records must distinguish permitted additional riders from required escort.

missing_evidence.name: for_hire_financial_security_proof
why: Must evaluate legally permitted financial responsibility methods, not assume standard PIP amount applies.

missing_evidence.name: insurance_policy_limits_and_status
why: Certificate document presence is not enough to prove $100,000 per person/$200,000 per incident and active coverage.

missing_evidence.name: lift_operation_training_and_test
why: WHEELCHAIR_SECUREMENT alone may not establish lift-operation testing for the assigned bus.

missing_evidence.name: medicaid_distance_denial_review
why: Need denial reason and routing policy to ensure geographic distance is not a prohibited criterion.

missing_evidence.name: medicaid_trip_cap_policy_review
why: Cannot infer policy compliance from an individual trip without reviewing program rejection logic.

missing_evidence.name: nonpublic_bus_liability_limits
why: Must check $100k/$300k/$50k or $300k combined alternative, not merely certificate presence.

missing_evidence.name: out_of_state_medical_service_prior_authorization
why: Medical service prior authorization unavailable.

missing_evidence.name: procedure_receipt_by_driver
why: Company policy presence does not prove each driver received procedures.

missing_evidence.name: td_liability_limits_verification
why: Insurance certificate must be evaluated for actual covered TD insurance limits and status.

missing_evidence.name: transit_driver_record_retention
why: Retention clock and audit preservation are not represented by a document's expiration.

missing_evidence.name: trip_ahca_broker_authorization
why: Need trip-specific broker authorization evidence; not a provider enrollment credential.

missing_evidence.name: trip_day_bus_inspection_and_defects
why: Vehicle inspection document type may not identify that the latest check occurred for the relevant service date or was acceptable.

missing_evidence.name: trip_eligibility_verification
why: Trip-level eligibility verification evidence is unavailable.

missing_evidence.name: trip_urgent_booking_review
why: Need indication that no prohibited advance booking requirement applied.

missing_evidence.name: vehicle_combined_licensure_compliance
why: Registration does not alone prove all applicable passenger transport vehicle requirements; composite qualification evaluation required.

missing_evidence.name: vehicle_pip_security_verification
why: Need proof of active PIP or legally accepted alternate financial security.

missing_evidence.name: vehicle_property_damage_security
why: Need validate applicable financial-security method and $10,000 coverage or an expressly authorized alternative.
